candidate.answerReason: Every element of A belongs to both copies of A. Thus A intersected with itself is {1,2,3}, containing three elements.

methods.label: Intersect a set with itself
methods.explanation: The elements common to \(A\) and itself are all the elements of \(A\), for a total of 3.
